extraction.Name: Charles Whipple
extraction.Refused/Protested: No, there was nothing said about it.
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Ida Walker - consideration $1100.00. Dated May 4, 1929, interest at 7% due May 10, 1921. Sold to T. C. Clark for $2500.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I was to pay the interest on the mortgage, and I have not yet been able to pay all this.
extraction.NOTES: Allottee states patent was forced on him: 'it was forced on me, and this is what became of it.' Has wife and seven children dependent on him. Did not sign receipt for patent or apply for it. Patent received from Issue Station at Parmelee. Document notarized June 4, 1929, before E. E. McKean, Superintendent.
